denominator.source: wpt.fyi summary_v2 at the WPT commit

engine: Foafnaut native engine, page scripts in QuickJS-NG in WasmVM on the Lean DOM and event loop
method: Stratified by top-level WPT directory (second level for WebCryptoAPI, css, dom, editing, encoding, html, selection, svg, third_party, wasm). Per stratum: the largest testharness names always run, the rest drawn with probability proportional to Chrome's subtests; estimate = measured + rest x mean pass ratio. Passed subtests of a name are capped at Chrome's count. Worker, ShadowRealm and module variants are not run and count 0. Range: 95% normal interval from per-stratum sampling variance (strata whose draws all scored 0 add no variance).

notCounted.note: wpt.fyi's summary gives tests without subtests (reftests, crashtests, visual) 0 subtests, so they weigh 0 in this denominator

engine.library: libweb-render.dylib from cache/bleeding/foafnaut (release-equivalent, built from main bfbed32a8)
engine.mode: --engine native, script clock as good as off (1e12 instructions a ms)

runs.what: stratified sample: 5,898 names in 442 strata (seed 20261108, 25 a stratum, the 5 largest always)

whole strata: dom/nodes, dom/events, dom/traversal, dom/collections, dom/abort, dom/(root), html/dom, html/syntax, html/webappapis, css/cssom, css/cssom-view, css/css-shapes, css/css-color, webaudio, scroll-animations (2,685 more names)
129 idlharness names again after adding wptserve's /resources/WebIDLParser.js rewrite (all still 0: idl_test fetches /interfaces/*.idl and there is no fetch)
208 names again after a refused page (a script over 4 MiB) left the session without its guest; the runner now loads it again

test262Inline.what: 300 Test262 names drawn at random (seed 262) from 52,273 .test262.html, run with --test262-inline: the page wptserve's iframe loads, run at top level under the outer page's test. Not a WPT result: wptserve runs it in an iframe, and the engine's native script session loads no iframe documents, so every Test262 name times out (0 counted).

diagnostics.iframeDocuments: The Lean page session can attach same-origin iframe documents (formal/lean4/L4Factoidal/WasmVM/Bench/Page.lean: frameLoads, attachFrame), but the native scriptSession takes no frame documents. The bench run of 8 November passed dom/nodes/ParentNode-querySelector-All.html (1,947), Element-matches.html and Element-webkitMatchesSelector.html (665 each) and 596/596 of Document-createElementNS.html; natively they time out or lose the iframe half.
diagnostics.fuel: A script session stops at about 4.29e9 WasmVM instructions ('WasmVM: out of fuel'). 11 html/dom reflection tests pass 5,416 subtests before it; at the pass rate of what they reported they would pass about 20,000 of their 63,062.
